issus , a, um, adj.,
I.a childish form of ipse, used with little children as a term of endearment: ISSA HAVE, Inscr. ap. Fabr. p. 45, n. 255.—Issa , the name of a pet slut, Mart. 1, 109.—Also dim.: ‡ issŭlus , a, um, Inscr. ap. Fabr. n. 254.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
